floors.clue: Having the status of a king, queen, or member of a sovereign family.
Resembling or suitable for a monarch; magnificent and dignified.
A ceremonial chair occupied by a sovereign on state occasions.
A young nobleman acting as an attendant to a knight before achieving knighthood.
A female ruler of an empire, or the wife of an emperor.
A member of the lowest hereditary chivalric order in Britain.
A British nobleman ranking above an earl and below a duke.
A sovereign state or feudal lord having control over another dependent state.
First in order of importance; a chief ruler or head authority.
Companions or advisers who attend the royal court of a monarch.
